title: Northgate Marketplace Order Structure and Per-Order Amounts
content:
**Standing rule.** A buyer of Northgate Marketplace Orders and the Northgate Marketplace Guarantee may have any number of marketplace orders; no limit applies to how many marketplace orders one buyer holds. A checkout containing items from several sellers creates one marketplace order per seller, and each order has its own shipping, returns and Northgate Marketplace Guarantee protection. Amounts on one order are never combined with another order's, and the guarantee maximum applies per order.

**Restated by object.**

| Subject | Unit it attaches to |
|---|---|
| Shipping charge | the marketplace order (one seller) |
| Returns | the marketplace order (one seller) |
| Guarantee protection and its maximum | the marketplace order (one seller) |
| Number of orders per buyer | no limit |

**Hypothetical illustration.** A checkout with items from three sellers produces three marketplace orders. A refund or a guarantee reimbursement on the first of them is counted only on that first order, and the guarantee maximum of each order is measured against that order alone.
